items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So John -- we got kind of together on the thing and so that's when I made oh, the first record that I had with Surrender Dear

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, it was at Forest Hills, yeah.
So John was there and he heard it and he said we've got to record it; and so they did it with Gene Krupa, you see.
But how did Mildred and Benny hit it off together?
